sources.title: FY2026 ended 30 June 2026 issuer financial update
sources.supports: The [FY2026 investor release hub](https://investors.adp.com/overview/default.aspx) identifies Q4/FY2026 as the latest completed period. FY2026 revenue was $21.95bn, up 7%. ADP stat

sources.title: Annual report / financial results
sources.supports: latest financial anchor used in packet

financial_anchor.caveat: about $5.4bn adjusted EBIT; reported operating profit is lower and should be used for statutory reconciliation; measure may be adjusted or a labelled scale proxy and is not normalized.

ai_claim.claim: ADP describes scoped AI/digital mechanisms in generative payroll/service assistance with expert escalation, anomaly and fraud detection in payroll and tax flows.
ai_claim.stage: E1; E2 only where management explicitly reports production use
ai_claim.scope: accurate payrolls per service hour, first-contact resolution, retention, net revenue per client and AI contribution after model cost
ai_claim.limitation: No controlled quality-adjusted company result tied to retained incremental cash was found.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Paychex and Rippling and other unified HR/payroll SaaS platforms can replicate tools or force gains through to customers.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Competitive capability does not by itself prove equal outcomes.

rights_limit: Employers and workers own or control personal data; ADP may process it under contract. Public privacy documentation does not establish permission for unrestricted cross-employer training.
materiality_summary: The labelled 5% scale hurdle is $250m; public evidence does not establish it.

arithmetic.formula: Using a $5.0bn reported-profit scale proxy, 5%=$250m. A $4bn eligible service/development pool×12%×60%×60%−$50m=$123m; pricing, PEO pass-through and released capacity must be reconciled.
arithmetic.result: Illustrative bridge remains below or must be compared with $250m; not a forecast.

g2_provisional: Open: E1/E2 evidence supports measurement, but E3 quality-adjusted causality and E4 cash retention are not established.
unresolved_questions: What share of eligible workload is in production?
What controlled quality-adjusted KPI result exists?
What do contracts permit for pooled learning and how much benefit is retained after recurring cost?
